shortDescription: South Korea’s imports surged 36.0% year-on-year in October 2026, below market expectations of 39.9% but accelerating from a 26.0% rise in the previous month, flash data showed.It marked the 12th consecutive month of growth in purchases, driven by robust domestic industrial demand.

title: South Korea Import Growth Below Forecasts
